q1.question: What is a packshot and why is it essential for e-commerce?
q1.answer: A packshot is a professional product photograph on a white background, standardized for online sales. It's the first visual contact between your product and the customer. Quality packshots increase conversion rates by an average of 30% and reduce product returns.

q2.question: How does an Orbitvu automated photo studio work?
q2.answer: Orbitvu studios automate the entire process: positioning, calibrated LED lighting, multi-angle and 360° capture, automatic background removal and export. An operator with no photography skills can produce professional packshots in 3 seconds per image.

q3.question: What is BlendAI and how does AI improve product photography?
q3.answer: BlendAI is our specialized packshot artificial intelligence solution. From your real photos, AI generates lifestyle scenes, contextual backgrounds and creative variations. Unlike pure generative AI, BlendAI preserves the visual integrity of your product.

q4.question: How quickly does an automated studio pay for itself?
q4.answer: Average ROI is achieved between 6 and 12 months depending on your production volume. Companies producing over 1,000 visuals per year see a return on investment from the 4th month. Use our ROI calculator for a personalized estimate.

q5.question: Are your training programs eligible for OPCO funding?
q5.answer: Yes, PackshotCreator Academy has been Qualiopi certified since 2023. All our packshot and AI training programs are eligible for OPCO funding, with coverage up to 100%. We guide you through the administrative process.

q6.question: What's the difference between PackshotCreator and a traditional photographer?
q6.answer: PackshotCreator offers a hybrid approach: Orbitvu automated hardware + BlendAI specialized AI + certified training. Our solutions deliver 10x higher productivity, consistent quality and 80% lower cost per image compared to traditional photography.

q1.question: How does OPCO funding work?
q1.answer: Your company (or yourself if self-employed) contacts its OPCO to request coverage. PackshotCreator provides the quote and detailed program. The OPCO can fund up to 100% of the training cost.

q2.question: What is the difference between Blended and In-Person?
q2.answer: Blended: 50% e-learning (videos at your own pace) + 50% in-person/video (intensive practice). Reduced price by 24-27%. In-Person: 100% in-class with the trainer. More interactions, 1:1 coaching, lunches included.

q3.question: Do I need to already have an Orbitvu studio to take Packshot training?
q3.answer: No, the training takes place in our Lyon showroom equipped with all studios (Alphashot, Station M, etc.). You can then decide to acquire your own equipment.

q4.question: Do AI training programs require a BlendAI subscription?
q4.answer: BlendAI access is included during training and for 30 days after. Then, you can subscribe to a plan (from €75/month) if you wish to continue.
